title: Email Verifier Pro
description: Verify email addresses in bulk with real SMTP checks. Paste emails directly, provide a CSV URL, or link an existing Apify dataset.

emails.title: Email Addresses
emails.description: Paste email addresses to verify. One per line.

csvUrl.title: CSV File URL
csvUrl.description: URL to a CSV file containing email addresses. Supports direct links, Google Sheets (published as CSV), and Dropbox links. The email column is auto-detected, or you can specify it below.

datasetId.title: Apify Dataset ID
datasetId.description: ID of an existing Apify dataset containing emails. Useful for chaining with other actors (e.g., scrape emails → verify them).

emailColumn.title: Email Column Name
emailColumn.description: Name of the column containing email addresses in your CSV or dataset. Leave empty for auto-detection (looks for columns named 'email', 'e-mail', 'Email Address', etc.).

concurrency.sectionDescription: Fine-tune verification speed, retries, and timeouts. The defaults work great for most use cases.
concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of emails to verify simultaneously. Higher = faster but may trigger rate limits on some mail servers.

maxRetries.title: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a verification if the mail server times out or returns a temporary error. Set to 0 to disable retries.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for each email verification. Increase this if you're verifying emails on slow or overloaded mail servers.

maxEmails.title: Maximum Emails (Optional)
maxEmails.description: Maximum number of emails to verify in this run. Leave empty for no limit.

freeTierNotice.title: ℹ️ Notice
freeTierNotice.description: Try up to 100 emails for free using the Apify Free Trial (configure in your Apify settings).
